title: Longlegs
review: The Nick Cage of it all isn't as crazy and distracting now that it's not in the zeitgeist and I'm not at the cinema. I think I the supernatural elements are a slight detriment to the otherwise grounded setting. If it had turned out to be a completely rational explanation then I might have liked it even more, for the same reasons I loved {Jonathan Creek} as a kid. Obviously my desire to see a giant Hell set that eclipses the budget for the rest of movie still stands, so it would have also liked it if Cage and Satan were rocking out in a montage at the end.
